title: plectranthus ovatus
intro: Plectranthus ovatus, commonly known as Spotted Coleus, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. The leaves of this plant have been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Plectranthus ovatus include its ability to exhibit anti-bacterial, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer properties, making it a potential natural remedy for several health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
